{{*}} [[Fairy rings]] ({{fairycode|BIS}}, {{Fairycode|DJP}}) |map = {{Map|name=Ardougne Zoo|x=2615|y=3272}} |type = building |leagueRegion = Kandarin }}{{Relativelocation|north=East_Ardougne{{!}}East Ardougne|west=Ardougne_Castle{{!}}Ardougne Castle|east=East_Ardougne{{!}}East Ardougne|south=South-east_Ardougne_mine{{!}}South-east Ardougne Mine}} The '''Ardougne Zoo''', located in the southern part of [[East Ardougne]], holds a variety of creatures gathered from across [[Gielinor]]. It is currently the only zoo in ''[[Old School RuneScape]]'', and is involved in a handful of [[quests]]. The Ardougne Zoo is the only place outside of [[Ape Atoll]] where the player can use a [[Karamjan monkey greegree|monkey greegree]]. ==Transportation== *[[Ardougne cloak]] teleport to the [[Ardougne Monastery]] and run north *[[Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|DJP}} to teleport near the [[Tower of Life]] and run north-west ** Code {{Fairycode|BIS}} can be used to go directly inside the unicorn pen *[[Spirit tree]] to the [[Khazard Battlefield]] and run east *[[Ardougne teleport]] and run south-west from the city centre *[[Charter]] a ship to [[Ardougne]] (run south-west) or [[Port Khazard]] and run (north-west) ==Creatures== *8 [[Parrots]] *2 [[Wolf#Level 64|Wolves]] ''(level 64)'' *1 [[Jogre]] ''(level 53)'' *1 [[Cyclops (Ardougne Zoo)|Cyclops]] ''(level 56)'' *3 [[Scorpion]]s ''(level 14)'' *4 [[Pit scorpion]]s ''(level 28)'' *2 [[Grizzly bear]]s ''(level 21)'' *3 [[Camel]]s *5 [[Snake]]s ''(level 5)'' *4 [[Penguin]]s (2 ''(level 2)'' attackable) (cage can be entered in a [[clockwork suit|penguin suit]]) *15 [[Monkey]]s ''(level 2)'' (cage can be entered by holding a [[Karamjan monkey greegree]]) *2 [[Unicorn]]s ''(level 15)'' (cage can be entered by the [[fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|BIS}}) *1 [[Ferret]] (after [[Eagles' Peak]]) The animals are all caged and (with exception to the parrots, camels, some penguins, some monkeys, and the ferret) may be fought by either using a [[halberd]] or by using [[Magic]] or [[Ranged]] attacks. ==Quests== The following quests involve the zoo: *[[Cold War]], which is started at by talking to [[Larry]] outside the penguin habitat. *[[Eagles' Peak]], which is started by talking [[Charlie]] outside the scorpion habitat and in which you catch a [[ferret]] for the zoo. *[[Eadgar's Ruse]], in which the player gets a parrot drunk to steal it from the zoo. *[[Monkey Madness I]], in which the player must free a monkey from the zoo. ==Monkey Madness I== In the [[quest]] [[Monkey Madness I]], a player offers an alliance to [[Awowogei]]; in order to proceed, the player must free a monkey from one of the cages. To do so, the player must change into a monkey. This can be done by wielding a Karamjan [[Monkey Greegree|monkey greegree]] and speaking to a [[Monkey Minder]], who will place the player in the monkey cage. Once a player is in the monkey cage, they can leave by either teleporting or unequipping the monkey greegree and speaking to the Monkey Minder again. After the quest, players can repeat this process to free more monkeys from the zoo. Doing this doesn't change the number of monkeys inside of the monkey habitat. ==Treasure Trails== [[File:Cryptic clue - dig ardougne zoo.png|thumb|The spot to dig at the zoo for ''"the beasts to my east..."'' clue.]] The zoo is featured in a [[hard clue]] in which the player can solve by digging by the torch between the [[penguin]]s and the [[scorpion]]s. {{East Ardougne}}
